- Black's rooks are actively placed on d8 and f8

White is getting mated or losing the queen—this is completely winning for Black.

**Coaching Note:** Back-rank tactics are deadly when your opponent's king has limited escape squares. Here, White's queen moved away from defense, leaving g1 unguarded. When you see a weak back rank + active pieces, look for rook checks that force the king into the open, then use your queen to deliver mate or win material. This pattern wins games at every level.
